summary: Tested new strategy «Cruce EMA 10/20» (ema_cross) on all three bots (Bybit /api, HotForex /api/fx, Pepperstone /api/pepper). Backend: existing test_iter55_ema_cross.py (10/10) + test_iter7_profiles_strategies.py (16/16) pass; new test_iter56_ema_cross_api.py 15/15 pass (meta rules/basis texts, all-disabled PUT → 422 on all bots, profile level 2 keeps ema_cross off on all bots + restore, backtest 'all' crypto/fx, /api/optimize BTCUSDT, /api/fx/optimize + walk-forward EURUSD, real LLM chat answer in Spanish says it's off ('No', disabled_strategies includes ema_cross) and explains CRUCE exit). Rendimiento 'Por estrategia' row shows APAGADO and toggle on/off works on all 3 bots (header syncs). Backtest dropdown includes the strategy; BTCUSDT (3 trades) and EURUSD (19 trades) render with 'Cruce EMA contrario' reason label. Docs: features 'Ocho/Siete estrategias' + Cruce EMA 10/20, Cómo usar mentions CRUCE, bot selector card '8 estrategias'. Start/stop works on all bots; no console errors. Found & fixed one stale FAQ text.

ui_bugs.issue: Said 'ocho/siete estrategias … (cinco de corto plazo …)' — should be 'seis de corto plazo' now that ema_cross exists. FIXED by testing agent (both crypto and fx branches).

critical_code_review_comments: engine.py / fx/engine_signals.py: _exit_on_cross only runs when self.running — with the bot stopped, open ema_cross positions are not closed on the opposite cross (SL/TP still protect them). Probably intended; consider documenting.

Enabling ema_cross makes the risk-profile card show 'PERSONALIZADO' (detect_profile mismatch) — expected given the opt-in design, but users may find it surprising; could exclude OPT_IN keys from detect_profile comparison.
Pre-existing: crypto POST /api/optimize runs optimize() synchronously in the event loop (fx uses asyncio.to_thread) — blocks the server for its duration.
